pages.title: Across the Room
pages.text: Fit lighting to the room; nightstands and glowstone support your next cozy arrangement.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the hanging-light item on first and second faces/fasteners. String increases slack, a stick reduces it; empty-hand interaction toggles lights. The recipe selects sequence, straightness and twinkling.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Combine individual lights with the hanging-light recipe; choose string or a stick and optional glowstone. Create a colored sequence with slack or a straight connection and optional twinkling.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click a hanging-light item on one block face and then another face or fastener. Hang a strand between its attachment points.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click a strand with string or a stick. Increase or decrease its slack; empty interaction can switch hanging lights on or off.
